title: Recurrence Relations and Characterization of Moments for the Extended Power Lindley Distribution under Progressive First Failure Censoring
content: This study explores the development of recurrence relations (RRs) for single moments (SMs) and product moments (PMs) based on progressive first-failure censored data (PFFCD) using the extended power Lindley distribution (EPLD). These RRs enable efficient computation of key statistical measures, such as means and variances, across varying sample sizes, reducing computational effort. The proposed approach extends existing methodologies and adapts to progressive type-II censoring schemes (PTIICS), broadening its applicability. This advancement enhances analytical frameworks and computational tools for statistical inference in models involving censored data.
